scope: A self-contained offline research tool with text retrieval, image similarity suggestions, combined queries, generated image text, and captured evidence. Visual similarity is not verified equipment identification.
supersedes_for_release_readiness: The original M1 identification contract remains unchanged in search_acceptance.json and must be reported separately. Failing its identification targets must never be described as passing them.
reason: The archive grew from 4337 to 8463 entities and now embeds substantially more source evidence. Reviewed independent-photo experiments with MobileCLIP2-S0, MobileCLIP2-B, DINOv2-small, and SigLIP2-B do not support the original automatic-identification promise. Release readiness instead requires reproducible retrieval, complete evidence, measured limitations, and bounded offline operation.

distribution.original_image_archives: Optional supplementary assets; all query models, indices, evidence and selected previews must be embedded in each executable.

quality_requirements.text_regression: All 73 required baseline cases pass; report every one of the 116 cases and compare recall@5 and MRR against M1.
quality_requirements.independent_photo_reporting: Execute all ready frozen held-out cases against a query-disjoint gallery. Report raw ranking and accepted-identification metrics separately, by task and scope, with Wilson intervals. Preserve missing, failed and excluded cases. No threshold tuning on held-out queries.
quality_requirements.uncalibrated_images: All image and combined suggestions must remain explicitly uncalibrated and no_supported_match; expose source associations and previews without asserting identity or probabilities.
quality_requirements.integrity: No filter leaks, duplicate entity results, broken source/media references, or fabricated observations. Validate every returned contribution against the exact bundle.
quality_requirements.coverage: Account for every source and every saved image outcome; provide per-source entity coverage and exclusions. Preview allocation must prioritize previously uncovered entities.
quality_requirements.reproducibility: Pinned models; identical cached offline dataset rebuild; verified original-image archives; source exports match captured bytes.
quality_requirements.native: All five platforms pass native functional, encoder parity, text regression and resource checks with network access blocked.

resource_targets.comparison_scope: Complete 8463-entity archive with at most 10000 indexed image views; absolute budgets apply to all five native targets. The original fixed-corpus relative regression remains a separate report.
resource_targets.latency_definition: Complete process launches including model loading and JSON output. First observed is not cache-cleared; repeated launches are not an in-process service.
